 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE NAWNEET KUMAR  PANDEY  ORAL ORDER 4 07-08-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the appellant as well as the learned APP for the State.
2. This appeal has been preferred against the Judgement of conviction dated 09/02/2024 and sentence dated 09/02/2024 passed by the Court of learned Special Judge, POCSO cum Addl.

Session Judge-VI, Kaimur, Bihar, in POCSO Case No. 29/2018 arising out of Kudra P.S. Case No.
255/2018, whereby and where under the present appellant was convicted offences punishable under Section 366, 376 of the I.P.C and section 4 of POCSO Act
and sentenced to undergo Rigorous Imprisonment for 10 years - and Rigorous Imprisonment for 3 years for the offence under section 366 of the IPC and fine of Rs. 25000/- and Rs. 10,000/- respectively,
In default there of 3 Patna High Court CR.
APP (SJ) No.1735 of 2024(4) dt.07-08-2025 month further simple imprisonment.
All the sentences shall run concurrently.
3. According to the allegation, the present appellant along with Deepak Pal and Chandan Choudhary kidnapped the minor daughter of the informant for marriage.
4. The victim was examined as PW-1.

She deposed the appellant, at the pretext of providing job,
allured her and took to Mumbai, where he committed rape upon her.

sentences.text: While making the prayer for bail and suspension of sentence, learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the victim, in her statement under Section 183 of BNSS, has stated that she had studied up to 9th standard, contrary to that, the Exhibit 7 (the matriculation examination certificate of the victim) shows that she has passed matric examination.
6. The Exhibit-7 is the matriculation certificate of the victim.
The date of birth mentioned on that certificate shows that she was minor at the date of occurrence.
Her date of birth is mentioned as 1-4-2001, whereas the occurrence is of 15-6-2018.
She did not pass the matriculation examination and the matriculation certificate shows that she failed in that examination.
It was the reason she stated that she has studied up to 9th standard.
Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.1735 of 2024(4) dt.07-08-2025 7.
I do not find merit in the submissions of the learned counsel for the appellant.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the appellant is hereby rejected.

(Nawneet Kumar Pandey, J) kundan/-
